critical_code_review_comments: AdminServiceCategories.js: pets card state is detected by substring 'Inactif' in card HTML — works but is text-fragile; future-proofing would benefit from an explicit data-testid like 'svc-cat-status-pets' carrying 'active' | 'inactive' (test-only suggestion).

TaxiHubPage.js modeDisabled relies on catConfig[mode.id]?.active===false. If /api/service-categories ever returns an empty list (network error), catConfig stays {} and modeDisabled is false — meaning a backend outage would NOT silently block bookings; backend create_ride still 400s. Acceptable defense in depth.
Pre-existing (not from this iter): Google Maps loaded synchronously, google.maps.places.Autocomplete deprecation warning. Not blocking but worth migrating per Iter 101 note.

Console 403 noise when navigating between admin and rider sessions on /admin — purely because rider transiently stays on /admin URL during the logout->login transition. Harmless. Could be hardened by clearing route on logout, but not a bug for this feature.
